title: D1/F8 — one pinned route-parameter grammar from schema to browser
description: The signed bundle authors `/receipt/{caseRef}`, declares `caseRef`, and supplies the incoming transition map. The host provides the runtime value; the strict shell resolves the concrete address without reading a second parameter grammar.
repair: Route.path now carries a schema pattern admitting only the pinned grammar, and Studio authoring preserves params[] plus edge maps while rejecting `:name` before export.
beforeThisReconciliation: The shell matched BOTH grammars in one pass and reported ROUTE-PARAM-GRAMMAR alongside, so the deep link worked here and 404d in any other conforming renderer.
